court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Smt. Priyanka Gupta vs Amit Kumar Gupta
facts_of_case: The parties were married in 2013, but the relationship suffered hardships leading to institution of certain cases. The respondent approached this Court by means of Criminal Misc. Application No. 10930 of 2018 to quash criminal case proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: A decree of divorce can be recalled within the time limit prescribed under Order IX Rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure.
legal_principles.held: The application under Order IX Rule 13 of the Civil Procedure Code seeking recall of the ex parte decree dated 11th January, 2019 has been rejected by the learned court below vide order dated 1st December, 2022.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure — Order IX Rule 13

legal_principles.principle: A party to a dissolved marriage can remarry after the decree of divorce has been finalized and there is no right of appeal or the time for appealing has expired.
legal_principles.held: When a marriage has been dissolved by a decree of divorce and either there is no right of appeal against the decree or, if there is such a right of appeal, the time for appealing has expired without an appeal having been presented, or an appeal has been presented but has been dismissed, it shall be lawful for either party to the marriage to marry again.

outcome.final_order: The earlier order dated 11th January, 2019 was recalled.
